range.heading: What we supply across the board
range.body: Take 3 supplies the performers who make a scene feel real: special action performers for the physical work in your background, trained dancers, models for campaign and character work, and stand-ins and picture doubles matched carefully to your leads. Each discipline is cast by people who understand what it demands on set.

briefs.label: Recent briefs
briefs.note: Each brief is a real production. `details` are the two rows under the brief; each label can be anything (Duration, Location, Style, Discipline), and a detail with an `href` becomes a link to that page. `note` is the short paragraph beneath: what we did on that production and how.

items.note: Seventy special action performers cast for the oars, rehearsed as crews until they pulled as one, and kept on the water for four months of shooting.
A core unit of SPACT soldiers who drilled together before the first day at Pinewood, so the background action held up under the camera.
Catwalk models cast from a working roster for the runway sequences in London, fitted and on set for the shoot days.
Thirty contemporary dancers cast and rehearsed with our choreographer, screen-ready for the sequence.

items.label: Our artists
items.heading: A chosen roster, not an open directory
paragraphs: Every artist is scouted, auditioned or assessed in person by the Take 3 team before they join, so when we put someone forward, we know how they work.
Not just quantity. An agency built on quality.

items.label: Our team
items.heading: Briefs move fast. So do we.
paragraphs: We understand briefs, and the clock behind them. A call at short notice gets a considered answer the same day, not a holding email, and the people we put forward are ready to work.
Film and television do not keep office hours, and neither do we. Someone from the team is on hand whenever a production needs them: before the shoot, on the day, and when the schedule changes.

items.label: Our clients
items.heading: Film, television and commercial
paragraphs: Production companies, assistant directors, choreographers, stunt coordinators and brands.
Feature films, television drama and entertainment, commercials and campaigns. Each asks something different of a performer, and each runs differently on the day. We cast with both in mind.
